laws.rule: On the Amalfi Coast road (SS163 Amalfitana), alternate number-plate rules apply from 10 am to 6 pm on set 2026 dates (Holy Week, late April to early May, weekends and holidays from June, every day in August and September, weekends in October): on even dates cars with plates ending in an even number may not drive, on odd dates odd plates may not. Residents of the coast's municipalities, taxis, hire cars with driver and emergency vehicles are among those exempt. Hire cars are not listed as exempt.

laws.rule: Pompeii tickets are nominal (named) and capped at 20,000 visitors a day; one entry per ticket.

Naples has a mayoral order for its nightlife (movida) areas, in force from 16 October to 16 November 2026. Areas include the Quartieri Spagnoli, the Centro Storico Antico, the Chiaia 'baretti' quarter, the Vomero and Bagnoli-Fuorigrotta. Takeaway alcohol is banned every day from midnight to 6 am. Venues must close by 1 am Sunday to Thursday, 2 am Friday and 3 am Saturday. Fines are EUR 25 to EUR 500 per breach (about A$40 to A$795 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = EUR 0.6293); the city has used a series of such orders for different squares, so check the city's news page for a renewal.
